theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_dema_weight_restrict_withDensity
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → O ⊆ U → V.weight.restrict O = ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (V.carrier.indicator V.mult x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
